text:
name: Agent Context
run-name: agent-context-${{ github.run_id }}

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      source_sha:
        description: Full SHA of the current source_branch head
        required: true
        type: string
      source_branch:
        description: main or an exact agent/task branch name
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: agent-context-${{ github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  prepare:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout trusted helper
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Publish bounded context
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: python3 scripts/agent/run.py context
